other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen who is a scientist or engineer working abroad at the time of nomination
Must be below 40 years of age
Must possess a higher degree (e.g., Ph.D., M.Tech, MD) and have adequate professional experience
Must not hold any permanent, tenure‑track, or contractual position in any Indian institute or university
Nomination must not come from the candidate’s Ph.D. guide or from the same institute where the candidate earned the doctorate
Research work must be in a new area or laboratory different from the one where the doctorate was obtained
If a fellow later obtains a permanent/tenure‑track/contractual position, the fellowship becomes forfeited
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend of ₹1,35,000 plus an annual research grant of ₹7 lakh and an overhead of ₹60,000.
